title: Data Assimilation in the Latent Space of a Neural Network
summary: autoencoder/LSTM latent dynamics with Kalman assimilation lowered physical-space error in an indoor CO2/air-transport case and ran far faster than standard assimilation; one offline case only.
ai_technology: Autoencoder maps states to latent space; LSTM predicts dynamics; Kalman filter assimilates observations there.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Indoor office CO2 case reports lower MSE than standard assimilation and ~six orders faster runtime.
evidence.unknown: One offline case, not deployment or health outcome.
evidence.ai_role: Autoencoder maps states to latent space; LSTM predicts dynamics; Kalman filter assimilates observations there.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
